preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: for each test case: 1 <= n <= 10**9 and 0 <= m <= n
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length of the string n is between 1 and 10^9, and the number of '1's m is between 0 and n.

postconditions.expression: for each test case: output is an integer representing the maximum value of f(s)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is an integer that represents the maximum value of f(s) for all binary strings s of length n with exactly m '1's.
